svg.title: OpenGrid orchestrator system architecture
svg.text: Processes, MQTT topic families, and PostgreSQL 17 (schema og) — as implemented on main @ 434d230; guardian checks and table summary updated to 6470cfa (R2)
Location /og/ → http://127.0.0.1:8080 (og-api) Require user: operator, viewer, og-op-a, og-op-b · sets X-Remote-User + X-OG-Proxy-Auth
Location /ogsim/ → http://127.0.0.1:8091 (ogsim.control) Require user: tester · /og/api/customer/: og-cust-* (customer API)
one database per workspace (og / og_t_<ws>); full table list: diagram 05
reservation, grant — ledger (K2 one-buyer, K13 lock)
hub, bank, hub_state, telemetry, heartbeat, alert, feed_obs, feed_status, forecast
utility, asset, service_transformer, feeder_limit, substation_limit — R2 (0025, 0029)
plan_value, plan_energy_value, plan_shadow_obligation, trace_anchor, customer tables (0026)
scada/wave/.../request — ogsim replies live, but nothing triggers one yet
Users: og_engine, og_guardian, og_safestop, og_sim, og_simctl, og_api
Dashed purple arrows are a logical handoff carried through a shared Postgres table + NOTIFY/LISTEN channel, not a direct RPC.
og-feeds and og-settle never open an MQTT connection (interfaces/mqtt/topics.md); og-api opens one only to publish scenario/cmd.
opengrid.contracts (contract/product_rule/opportunity/obligation) is written from BOTH og-engine (automatic intake) and og-api (operator CRUD + manual admit).

SCADA ingest (fleet.ingest_scada_signal) is memory-only; persistence moved to flush() alongside telemetry (NEW, 708182a) -- a per-message commit on the ingest path fell behind under load (live 2026-09-25).
og_api subscribes to NO MQTT topic for its SSE streams (interfaces/mqtt/topics.md) -- those poll Postgres directly; its only MQTT use remains the scenario/cmd publish noted above.

og-sim-customer (D-11, IN PROGRESS): deploy/RUNBOOK.md lists its systemd unit as installed but not enabled -- integration-sims/src/ogsim/customer has 0 files on this checkout (grep); not drawn as a live box.
BUILD.md §1,4,5 (process table, ports, MQTT users) · orchestrator/config/orchestrator.toml · interfaces/mqtt/topics.md
